verdict.rationale: Lago's Dunning Agent reads a customer's payment/invoice history and disputes before chasing overdue invoices, and cash-collection filters surface overdue/unpaid invoices, showing some automated collections tooling, but there is no documented mechanism for automatically retrying failed renewal charges on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence, nor any recovery-rate metrics. missing for 10: explicit automated payment-retry scheduling/cadence logic, ML-based retry optimization, and measured churn-recovery evidence.
